violation_type.title: Written Activity Plans - Identify Groups and Plan Dates (26 TAC §744.2005(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plans - Identify Groups and Plan Dates
violation_type.typical_finding: An activity plan for the week was not available for review.

finding_variants.text: An activity plan for the week was not available for review.

The operation did not have a written activity plan.  There was nothing to show what activities are to be done at a specific time and as a result after being in care for 2 hours all the children did was play on ipads and eat their meal.
